title: A grounded summary at three sizes, over genre DMD priors — state at EOT 2026-10-02
text:
GOAL: write a summary of a source at 1 sentence / 5 sentences / 3 paragraphs, with no model calls and every line grounded in the raw source. Target document: 'By the Numbers: No Turn on Red, Nashville Safety, and Big Boss Babies Downtown' (advocacy data brief, 2026). Goldens at the-fold/fixtures/summary-goldens/no-turn-on-red.golden.json; derivation at the-fold/fixtures/summary-goldens/DERIVATION.md; source text at no-turn-on-red.txt (pdftotext -layout, ~20k chars).

LAW (holds): a summary is NOT written; it is a CURATION of the source's own sentences — select, order, stitch verbatim spans. Grounding is structural (every line is a substring at an offset), length is a selection budget not a generation budget. This is the same shape as the entity profile's summaryText (holodeck-profile.js small/medium/full).

BUILT: the-fold/holodeck-summary.js (365 lines) + holodeck-summary.test.mjs (11/11 pass). Implements: tokens/cosine/vectors (exact TF-IDF, no hashing); fieldsOf/excessOf/admit (holographical excess against a baseline H); surprisePass (walk claims along the arrow of time); resolverEdges (S(a|B∪{b}) < S(a|B), name-sharing gate so a resolver is ABOUT the turn, null-controlled against shuffled material); worth() (summary-worthiness = excess-per-figure + name-centrality + resolvability); select()/ladder() (greedy MMR, monotone: 1 ⊆ 5 = 3-paragraph spans); attestPrior/turnAgainstPrior (the VOID: a model may PROPOSE priors, the source must ATTEST them or they are inert). Tests hold for G (grounding), M (monotone), N (resolver null), A (attestation).

THE CORRECTION (the point of this session): the baseline B must be a GENRE, not the document. A baseline built from the document itself takes its first principles as gospel — the essay's quoted objection becomes the prior and its first principles the ground (circular). B is now the shared MODE of genre-similar texts, measured by DMD (eoreader7/native/kernel/dmd-stream.js): eigenvalues carry magnitude AND frequency, so a genre's standing shape is a mode and the document's departure from it is its holographical surprise. The quantity is BAYESIAN surprise (bayes-surprise.js: KL(posterior‖prior) in bits, 'how much x changed what the reader believes'), NOT occurrence surprisal (−log₂ p(x)) — the essay's turn is not rare, it REORGANIZES the picture. The window is activation.js::dmdWindow — 'the shallowest depth at which forgetting everything older changes no conclusion' (Bateson's difference that makes a difference).

GENRE PRIORS BUILT: live_priors/derived-priors/genre-priors/genre-prior.mjs + government-legal.json, encyclopedic.json, literature.json, academic.json. Discipline inherited from concern-field.mjs: G² (Dunning) over-representation vs the corpus's own population, two independent document-split arms (intersection = prior, drops = the dissent), named gaps for genres below 8 documents (news=1, western-canon=5 are NAMED GAPS, never approximated).

OPEN (do not tune a constant to hide it; test R is marked OPEN on purpose): pure holographic excess over this document surfaces the DATA SECTION's turns, not the essay's VERDICT ('these 59 NTOR signage seems to be good, targeted policy' — low figure-excess, its surprise is rhetorical and lives in the genre-mode departure, not the entity/figure holograph). genreBaseline() refuses to run without a genre TRAJECTORY (per-document observables fed through the same extractor) and refuses the document as its own ground; that trajectory is not yet wired. Next build: feed dmdWindow the genre's own `derive` (conclusionOf over the genre corpus's claims) so departureDepth measures where this document makes a difference the genre did not hold, then re-run the ladder. A scratch runner (per-document states + departureDepth) was drafted but not run to completion; it hit a path error and was left at EOT deliberately — the module and its tests are the durable artifact.

FILES: the-fold/holodeck-summary.js, holodeck-summary.test.mjs, fixtures/summary-goldens/{no-turn-on-red.golden.json,DERIVATION.md,no-turn-on-red.txt}; live_priors/derived-priors/genre-priors/{genre-prior.mjs,*.json}; dependency: eoreader7/native/kernel/dmd-stream.js (works in node; NOT yet vendored into the-fold, only activation.js is).
